Hi Elena —

Appreciate the fast turnaround and the docs. I've looped in Monica from AP and Marissa from Finance so we can evaluate the Net10 pilot and confirm PO capture requirements. Quick notes / next steps: 

1) Monica will confirm what supporting docs we need for an early-pay pilot (tax docs, bank info, vendor scoring).
2) Finance (Marissa) will run the proposed 1.5% discount against our unit economics for the first 90 days and confirm approval thresholds.
3) Karthik will scope whether this needs a PO exception or a standard PO with a special payment term tag.

Can we do a 20-min sync on Monday 9am PT? If that time doesn't work, propose an alternate.

On the pilot mechanics: our standard policy is Net30. We do run short-term pilot exceptions for strategic partners or where a discount compensates for the cash velocity change. We'll confirm the internal approvals this week and follow up with a mutual action plan and an intake checklist.

Thanks — looking forward to getting LumaTech live.

Hi Elena / Logan —

Thanks — I reviewed the attached form. To consider a Net10 pilot we need the following from LumaTech: 

- Completed vendor form (we received) + signed W-9 (we received)
- Bank account verification (voided check or ACH letter)
- Contact for invoice submission and remittance (email + AP contact)
- Confirmation of the proposed early-pay discount (percent + duration) — you noted 1.5% for 90 days, please confirm in writing
- PO requirements: if LumaTech prefers Net10 for the pilot we will create a dedicated PO with an "EP" (early pay) tag so AP can route payments to the accelerated queue.

A couple of policy points: Redwood requires an internal finance sponsor for any term exceptions longer than 30 days; for a 90-day pilot this must be approved by Finance (Marissa is cc'd). If we proceed, we will: 

- Spin up a pilot PO and set payment priority to "expedite" in our AP queue
- Start with Net30 default, apply the early-pay discount (1.5%) at time of settlement if LumaTech elects early-pay within Net10
- Evaluate settlement behavior and decide by the end of the pilot whether to make the terms permanent

Please send the ACH verification and your AP contact and we'll run this through validation. If you're okay, I'll create the pilot PO and a short mutual action plan doc for signatures.

Best,
Monica Patel
Accounts Payable Manager | Redwood Inference
